desc:
A meal prep planner for high-protein batch cooking, in Google Sheets. Pick what to cook on one or two prep days, see the protein, carbs, fat, kcal and cost of every portion, fill the week's containers, and get a budget grocery list in whole packs, sorted by aisle. Then tick it off on your phone in the shop.

You get a PDF with links to your own Google Sheet: a blank copy and a filled-in example. Plan on your laptop, shop and cook with your phone in the free Google Sheets app. Not for Excel or Numbers, and not a printable.

INSTANT DOWNLOAD: open the PDF, tap the link and press "Make a copy". Nothing is shipped.

WHAT'S INSIDE
• Start Here: five simple steps, plus tips
• Setup: your name, currency, weekly food budget, protein goal, your two prep days, what a bought meal costs you and how many containers you own
• Foods: 36 common foods with typical label values filled in (check your own labels), plus your pack sizes, prices and what you have at home. Cost per 10 g of protein is worked out
• Recipes: 16 high-protein batch recipes to start, with room for 30. Protein, carbs, fat, kcal and cost a portion are worked out for you
• Prep Plan: up to 4 recipes on each prep day, with batches, portions, eat-by dates and spare or short portions. Then a 7-day grid of breakfast, lunch, dinner and snack containers with protein and cost a day
• Grocery List: builds itself from your prep days, by aisle, in whole packs, with the till total against your budget
• Phone: today's containers and protein, then your list with tick boxes
• Prep Day: the exact amounts to cook for each batch, with the method
• Prep Log: one line a week for your prep streak and roughly what you saved vs buying meals
• Dashboard: pick All recipes or one recipe and every number and chart follows. Cards for portions, protein a portion, cost a portion and the shop vs your budget, each with a mini chart. Protein by day vs your goal, where a portion's calories come from, made vs eaten for each recipe, key checks and what needs a look
• More from Kova: our other Google Sheets

WHY IT SAVES TIME
• Change batches to 2 and every amount and the shopping list double
• The same food in two recipes is added up: chicken for bowls + wraps = one line
• Already have it at home? It comes off the list
• A meal planned later than its keep days turns red, so you know what to freeze
• More portions than containers? It tells you before you cook
• The dates move on each week by themselves

WORKS ON laptop, tablet and phone (free Google Sheets app). It needs a free Google account. It does not work in Excel or Numbers.

PLANNING FAMILY DINNERS RATHER THAN PREP DAYS? Our Weekly Meal Planner & Grocery List is made for that. Search KovaStudioHQ on Etsy.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Download the PDF after purchase
2. Tap the link and press "Make a copy"
3. Add your prices, pick your prep-day recipes, then shop and cook from your phone

GOOD TO KNOW
• The photos show example data. Your copy starts with the recipes and foods filled in and your own prices to add.
• This is a planning tool, not nutrition or diet advice. Values come from the labels you enter.
• Personal use only. Please don't share or resell the file or link.
• Because it's a digital item, returns aren't accepted, but message me if anything doesn't work and I'll fix it.

Designed and built by Kova Studio. AI tools helped during the build.
